frontier_selector.why: The presence of a well-circumscribed intradural extramedullary lesion with specific imaging characteristics and the diffuse positive staining for protein S-100 decided it.

support_spans: A 35 × 9 mm sized mass occupying the spinal canal at T8-T9 level
Well-circumscribed intradural extramedullary lesion, hypointense on T1-weighted images and heterogene hyperintense on T2-weighted images
The lesion compressing the spinal cord from posterior showed peripheral rim enhancement around the central cystic area after contrast media injection
contradict_spans: Neoplastic cells were negative for epithelial membrane antigen, pancytokeratin and desmin but diffuse positive for protein S-100
